title: [Bug] AttributeError: items when using Custom OpenAI/DeepSeek models (Pydantic ConfigDict clash)
author: ahmetselimince

comments.author: laithrw
comments.body: Hey @ahmetselimince-web, this isn't a supported integration. Agent expects a browser_use.llm.BaseChatModel, not a raw LangChain ChatOpenAI subclass. You could instead use browser_use.ChatOpenAI(base_url="https://api.deepseek.com/v1", model="deepseek-chat", ...) directly (or ChatDeepSeek if you want the native wrapper). If you need LangChain specifically, there's the ChatLangchain adapter in examples/models/langchain.
